name: Tokyo Freaks
source: Akira can steal your soul without ever laying a hand on you. In rain-soaked Neo-Tokyo, he is the “Voice” of the Unholy Three, forging digital lies that kill. Bound to Kenji—the child-bodied mastermind—and Goro, the brutal cybernetic enforcer, he cannot escape. But as their empire rises from Akihabara’s shadows to Roppongi’s bloodlit towers, his conscience begins to fracture. In a city of manufactured truth, finding your own voice might be the deadliest mistake of all.
translation: 阿基拉无需对你下手就能偷走你的灵魂。在雨水浸透的新东京，他是邪恶三人组的“声音”，伪造数字谎言以杀人。他被孩子般的策划者Kenji和残酷的控制论执行者Goro束缚住了，他无法逃脱。但当他们的帝国从秋叶原的阴影崛起到六本木的血光塔楼时，他的良心开始崩溃。在一个制造真相的城市里，找到自己的声音可能是最致命的错误。
